_comment: Where you can work. Based in Canada: Canadian jobs pass whether remote, hybrid or onsite, and get a score boost. US jobs pass only when remote, and are flagged so you check work authorization. Remote jobs open worldwide or to North America pass. Jobs tied to any other country or region are dropped. Matching is case-insensitive whole-word text matching; see lib/filters.js.
notes: A location naming Canada or the US is judged by the rules above even if it also names other places ('Europe, USA, Canada' passes). Add a city to place_aliases.canada if a Canadian posting slips through.
